text:
alex: wrapping up my shift — quick state before i log off

alex: incidents: embed-ingest queue spiked ~15m ago, regen backlog up to ~900 items, error rate on eu-west1 kvcache reads ~0.6% (baseline 0.05%)

maria: noted. is the spike correlated with the nightly batch job?

alex: yes, looks like a bad batch window hit a few heavy queries. cron job id: batch-embed-03. i paused the job and set parallelism=2.

sam: nice. did we throttle clients or scale?

alex: scaled regen-workers +2 (autoscaler latched), and flipped fallback routing to lower-capacity model for non-critical routes. metrics showing ingress drop after ~3m.

lee: can you paste the commands you used? will take over on deploys

alex: sure — copied exact steps:
```
# pause the nightly batch
kubectl -n ingestion scale job batch-embed-03 --replicas=0
# bump regen workers
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/regen-workers && kubectl -n inference scale deploy/regen-workers --replicas=12
# fallback routing toggle (console)
# routed /v1/regen -> model-reduced-capacity for tenant-tier=free
```

deploy-bot: Deploy 1743 started by alex — canary -> prod (regen-workers).

maria: monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ingest/queue?panel=3 — backlog trending down but still noisy.

sam: PR pings — @lee can you review PR #4821 (regen backpressure fix) and #4823 (kvcache read-path guard)? they're small and targeted.

lee: on it, will try to get to #4821 in the next hour. if it's quick i can merge and ship canary.

alex: blockers for me: need one more sign-off on #4821 before i handoff autoscaler reset. otherwise low risk.

maria: noted — i'll watch post-merge and keep the batch job paused until midnight window clears.

sam: ops checklist for next shift:
- continue to watch eu-west1 kvcache errors
- confirm backlog <200 before unpausing batch
- if error rate >1% for 10m, revert routing to prior model and open incident channel

lee: quick status update: found a minor race in kvcache client, added a defensive check in #4823. unit tests added.

alex: handoff for infra keys: i left the scaler config pinned at target=10. i'll annotate the runbook with current values.

maria: thanks alex. i have takeover — i'll post a short follow-up if anything pops. please drop any terminal logs or traces here if you leave. :thumbsup:

alex: adding one log snippet that looked suspicious earlier:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:17Z ERROR kvcache read timeout tenant=acme req_id=abc123 latency_ms=1200
2026-03-18T03:12:18Z WARN regen queue enqueue failed retry=1 item=embedding-xyz
```

sam: good context. maria — i'm assigning you the incident owner until morning. i'll be reachable if needed.

maria: got it — taking owner. logging into oncall pager and updating status page if we need an incident page.

lee: merged #4821, started canary. pinging once canary is stable.

deploy-bot: Canary 1743 -> prod: 3/3 healthy checks passed.

lee: canary looks clean, i'll promote in 5m unless anyone objects.

alex: no objections from me. thanks team, leaving notes in the handoff doc.

maria: promoted. backlog down to ~180. i'll leave the batch paused until 0100 UTC. handing off to oncoming shift. :wave:

sam: thanks all. nightly notes: PRs to watch #4821 #4823, queue threshold 200, kvcache error threshold 1% over 10m.

maria: i'm adding those to the shift summary and tagging oncall-schedule. good handoff.
